**Evaluating optimizer requirements**

I’m looking at the harness optimizer, which doesn’t need every candidate evaluated on the same held-out suites. It calculates the mean from available data and can select a candidate based on an easy held-out check versus others that are more difficult. I think there will need to be fair gating for "held-out harness selection." To fix P1 data integrity, I need identical non-empty suite sets for all candidates or aggregate per suite with a missing evaluation error.
